name: Tun Pikrama
bio: Pikrama can hear a request meant for his predecessor, but the old promises carry no automatic weight with his household.
notes: fact: Brown names the successor and records his death after the retreat at Muar; the later Paduka Tuan was a different man (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 164, 169–170; notes 549, 793)
inference: Pires’s unnamed Bendahara who counsels peace fits Brown’s succession, but the identification is not explicit (Pires II, p. 280; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: New terms for old petitions are fictional, not a measure of his ability or loyalty (people-factions.md §2)
